summary:
Allwork.Space republishes a Reuters brief reporting that Anthropic launched new workplace productivity features for Claude on a Thursday, as AI vendors compete to expand their business-user toolkits.

Key announcements:

1. Claude Dashboards, available in beta on paid plans, connects to business data platforms and customer-management (CRM) systems, letting users build live dashboards and analyses from plain-language queries rather than code.

2. Claude Motion, in beta for Team and Enterprise customers, lets users create editable animations and export them as video files.

3. Anthropic positioned both tools as ways for users to analyze business data and produce visual content without coding skills.

4. Claude Docs, Slides and Design moved from beta to general availability across all Claude plans.

The framing is competitive: AI companies are broadening suites of workplace productivity applications to win business users. The piece is a short news item with no analysis of workplace operations, facilities, hybrid policy, or governance implications, and no usage, pricing or adoption figures are given. Reporting credited to Jeffrey Dastin (San Francisco) and Prathik Jayaprakash (Bengaluru), edited by Shilpi Majumdar.
